name: Pichwai Cow Shubh Labh Hanging
description: A pair of hand-painted Pichwai-style cows carrying Shubh and Labh, finished with a gold ring, kundan paisleys, pearl strings and cowrie-shell tassels. Lovely on either side of your main door or mandir.

name: Rose Crescent Shubh Labh Hanging
description: A tall statement pair with a gota crescent moon, soft silk roses, a mirror-work lotus, a Shubh Labh medallion and a Pichwai cow, ending in beaded gold tassels.

name: Red Gota Shubh Labh Hanging
description: Round red silk hangings with golden Shubh and Labh lettering, a gota-patti flower border and rows of gold and pearl drops.

name: Ganesha Gota Wheel Hanging
description: A golden Ganesha set in a navy-and-gold gota wheel, with a festive top medallion and a little embroidered Shubh or Labh cushion at the bottom.

name: Pichwai Lotus Cow Hanging
description: Mustard Pichwai panels with a mirrored jharokha arch, lotus and cow, hung from a white jasmine garland and finished with pink beaded balls and a silk tassel.

name: Swastik Shubh Labh Latkan Set
description: A traditional set of three latkans with embroidered Shubh, Labh and Swastik cushions, gota wheels, pom-poms and silk tassels in festive yellow, pink and red.

name: Orange Gota Labh Hanging
description: A bright string of orange gota wheels and pearls under a pink embroidered Labh cushion, finished with fluffy pink pom-pom tassels.

name: Lakshmi Ganesh Evil Eye Hanging
description: Lakshmi and Ganesha panels framed in floral blue, topped with a beaded evil-eye charm and pink blossoms, with a mirror-work lotus and pearl tassels below.

name: Red Chandbali Rose Hanging
description: Chandbali-style hangings with a red thread ring, kundan paisleys, pearl hoops, silk roses and red and gold tassels. Made for weddings and Karva Chauth.

name: Pink Lotus Chandbali Hanging
description: A hot-pink thread ring with a sparkling gota lotus, a golden chandbali hoop and magenta silk tassels. Perfect for mehndi and sangeet décor.

name: Diya Flower Hanging
description: A painted wooden diya on a long pearl string, topped with a bunch of silk flowers and finished with gold ghungroo beads.

name: Lotus Pom-Pom Bell Hanging
description: A slim string of magenta and marigold pom-poms with two layered wooden lotuses and a golden bell at the bottom. Looks great beside doors and windows.

name: Green & Gold Cushion Latkan
description: A double strand of embroidered green and mustard cushions with gota beads, pom-poms and pearls. A cheerful classic for any festival.

name: Pink Rose Gota Toran
description: A door toran (bandhanwar) in pink lattice gota fabric with silk roses, green-and-gold gota medallions and pearl drops ending in jasmine flowers.

name: Rose & Jasmine Garland Hanging
description: Deep red rose and white jasmine garlands with layered gold bead caps and red lotus-bud drops. Elegant on doors, mandaps and backdrops.

name: Marigold Bell Garland
description: A reusable marigold (genda phool) garland in orange and yellow with a gota wheel, rainbow pom-pom strands and brass bells.

name: Rainbow Pom-Pom Mirror Garland
description: Tall double strands of red, yellow, green and pink pom-poms joined by mirror-work links and gold drops. A burst of colour for garba nights and mehndi.

name: Jewelled Peacock Wall Décor
description: Hand-embellished peacock wall pieces with rhinestones, pearls and enamel feather work. Group a few sizes together for a stunning wall display.
